newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan cotton rates slip on high supply.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan cotton rates slip on high supply.

text.p: Pakistani cotton rates slipped on Wednesday amid a surge in supplies from the new 1997/98 crop and could come off further in the next few sessions, dealers said .
"If spinners continue to buy small quantities, the rates are likely to fall further as the new-crop supply is on the rise," one dealer said.
In the kerb market, the NIAB-78 variety was traded at 2,250 rupees ($55.39) per maund (37.32 k.g) and the MNH-93 at 2,260 rupees, dealers said.
